title: Code, protocols and results for verifiable bearing fault diagnosis with physically grounded vibration evidence
description: Analysis code, frozen research protocols, data manifests with SHA-256 hashes and result tables for the study on physically grounded vibration evidence for verifiable bearing fault diagnosis on unseen bearings. The study evaluates envelope-spectrum concepts with identifiability checks on 15 Paderborn bearings by nested bearing-disjoint cross-validation, tests model dependence on the named fault-frequency evidence by targeted interventions with matched controls, and reports a single external evaluation on 20 University of Ottawa bearings. The third-party vibration datasets are not included and can be obtained from their original sources.
